title: Mechanisms of diterpenes from Scutellaria Barbata D. Don against colorectal cancer via network pharmacology and experimental verification.
authors: Yang, Yuru; Cheng, Xiaotian; He, Yaonan; Chen, Tingting; Chen, Di; Wang, Andong
one_liner_zh: 该文通过网络药理学和实验验证研究半枝莲二萜类化合物抗结直肠癌机制，涉及HIF1A靶点，但无蛋白质-DNA互作、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Annually, colorectal cancer (CRC) claims nearly 700,000 lives globally, thereby positioning it among the most lethal diseases worldwide. Scutellaria barbata D. Don (BZL), acknowledged for its demonstrated efficacy, is currently undergoing investigation as a potential therapeutic recourse for this formidable cancer. Seven diterpenes were tested, leading to identification of BZL-5 as the most promising compound. It exhibits activity against colorectal cancer via a number of different targets and mechanisms. Its ability to combat oxidative stress, inflammation, and apoptosis is believed to be the mechanism of action. With respect to BZL-5, HIF1A exhibits the highest binding affinity, and HIF-1 may be a crucial component in the pharmacological pathway. Experimental verification in vitro was explored the possible mechanism of BZL against colorectal cancer using a thorough analytical approach. The overarching objectives of this investigation are to demystify the underlying molecular mechanism and identify potential targets instrumental in the development of novel colorectal cancer therapeutics.
abstract_zh: 每年，结直肠癌（colorectal cancer, CRC）在全球夺走近70万人的生命，从而使其跻身于全球最致命的疾病之列。半枝莲（Scutellaria barbata D. Don, BZL）因其已证实的疗效而受到认可，目前正被研究作为这种严峻癌症的潜在治疗选择。测试了七种二萜类化合物，其中BZL-5被鉴定为最具前景的化合物。它通过多种不同的靶点和机制展现出抗结直肠癌活性。其对抗氧化应激、炎症和细胞凋亡的能力被认为是其作用机制。就BZL-5而言，HIF1A表现出最高的结合亲和力，且HIF-1可能是其药理通路中的关键组成部分。通过体外实验验证，采用全面的分析方法探讨了BZL对抗结直肠癌的可能机制。本研究的总体目标是揭示其潜在的分子机制，并识别有助于开发新型结直肠癌疗法的潜在靶点。
